Add the configurable Storefront Switcher widget to your Home or Lock Screen to quickly change App Store countries with just a tap. You can customize each Widget to be a different country so you can switch between them quickly.


SHORTCUTS

Using just your voice, you can switch storefronts thanks to support for Siri Shortcuts.
